score_formula: For every applicable component convert agreement with the expected vector to match_i in [0,1]; model_score=sum(weight_i*match_i)/sum(applicable_weight_i); report every raw component and all three ablation radii beside the score
minimum_interpretive_support: Opposite direct polarity must recur beyond one locus, survive at least radius-one family ablation and agree with either exact state-pair alignment or high radius-two cofield similarity
replacement_rule_de: M01 replaces separate flower-versus-seed defaults only if it leads every other model by at least 0.10 and both family-ablated direct polarity plus one independent nonhistorical component agree; then keep the shared part as Blüten-/Fruchtstand until flower versus fruit separates
tie_or_failure_rule_de: Without that lead, retain M01 as a live rival and keep each whole's inherited replaceable default
